# GroupDocs.Viewer documentation

> On-premise SDK docs for rendering Microsoft Office, PDF, CAD, email, archive, image and 190+ other formats to HTML, PDF, PNG and JPEG, and reading document information without rendering.
> Platforms: net | java | python-net | nodejs-java | mcp
> .NET TFMs: net462, net6.0, net6.0-windows, net8.0, net8.0-windows, net10.0, net10.0-windows

## Hubs

- https://docs.groupdocs.com/viewer/net/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/viewer/java/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/viewer/python-net/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/viewer/nodejs-java/
- https://docs.groupdocs.com/viewer/mcp/
